Title: Users may see an erroneous error when sharing agents in Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder

User impact: Users may see an erroneous error when sharing agents in Microsoft Copilot Agent Builder.

More info: The Copilot Agent is shared as expected, but users may see an error message that reads: "We couldn't save your sharing settings. There was an issue saving sharing settings. Try again.” This error is purely a UI issue and is non-blocking.

Current status: We determined that an underlying code issue in the service is resulting in this incorrect message in the User Interface and have deployed a fix to address this issue. We'll monitor this fix and provide a remediation timeline as soon as one becomes available.

Scope of impact: This impacts any user attempting to share agents in Copilot Agent Builder, who may see an erroneous error. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: An underlying code issue in the service is resulting in this incorrect message in the User Interface.

Next update by: Thursday, November 5, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC
